ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 45:55 low-intensity (black) to high-intensity (white/off-white) pixel distribution across the visible ventral plane.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Centralized, contiguous black pigment block originating from the peduncle and extending to the median notch. The outer 60% of both lobes are primarily high-intensity white, with secondary black mottling concentrated along the upper trailing edge of the right lobe and scattered focal points on the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide, shallow U-shaped notch with an approximate vertex angle of 115 degrees and a vertical depth ratio of 0.15 relative to lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire margin. Amplitude is highest on the inner trailing edges; notable secondary indentation (chunk) located approximately 200 pixels right of the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the lateral margins terminating in sharp, acuminate tips with an upward (dorsal) orientation.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast dark clusters observed at the distal tips of both lobes, consistent with barnacle attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of linear pixel disruptions; left lobe contains three parallel vertical rake marks and multiple intersecting horizontal scratches. Right lobe exhibits diagonal white-on-black linear abrasions.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular notch/excision on the right inner trailing edge, appearing as a non-symmetrical loss of fluke tissue.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique dark pigmentation pattern on the mid-left lobe resembling a character-like glyph (similar to an 'H' or 'K').
